notes: Church website found 2026-09-10: connectionsvineyard.org. Vineyard USA congregation at 3150 E Ft Lowell Rd, Tucson AZ 85716 (the site labels this a mailing address but it is also the meeting location per the Sunday service listing); coordinates are still only approximate, run tools/geocode.py. LEADERSHIP HAS CHANGED: the Ministry Leaders page now reads 'Please welcome our new Pastors, Jeff and Diane Wright. Jeff and Diane have over 30 years of leadership experience in the Vineyard.' David and Trina Petrash, who were seeded from third-party directories, are no longer named anywhere on the church's own site and have been set active:false rather than deleted; their tenure dates were never confirmed. The site's About page still contains older copy referring to 'Rick and Marilyn (our Senior Pastors)' as the founders - that page is stale and Rick and Marilyn's surnames are not given, so neither is recorded. Which of Jeff or Diane normally preaches is still unknown. Media: the site nav links a YouTube channel (@connectionsvineyardchurch1479) and a Facebook page, and has a 'Past Sermons' page serving MP3 audio; only one sermon MP3 was visible there, so check whether the YouTube channel carries a usable run of recent full sermons before scheduling a review.
